The '''Taiylsh Desert''' is a vast, cold desert and grassland region located in central [[Ayuma]]. Covering an area of approximately 5,331,000 kilometers squared, it ranks as the second-largest desert in the world. The desert features a mix of [[wikipedia:Plateau|rocky plateaus]], sparse [[wikipedia:Grassland|grasslands]], and [[wikipedia:Semi-arid_climate|arid plains]], making it a unique ecosystem in contrast to the more commonly known sandy deserts.

The name “Taiylsh” is derived from the [[Kaalsite language|Kaalsite]] word ''taiy'', historically used to refer to all arid, waterless regions within the incuding the [[Ikzener Plateau]]. In the [[Ukhdari language]], however, the term is specifically applied to rocky, semi-desert regions like the Taiylsh, distinguishing it from sandy deserts such as the [[Siita Desert]].
==Geography==
===Features===
The Taiylsh Desert is a predominantly flat, [[wikipedia:Desert_climate#Cold_desert_climates|cold desert]] characterised by arid landscapes and extensive sand basins. While much of its territory consists of barren desert plains, the region also contains several large sandy depressions and [[wikipedia:Dune|dune fields]]. The desert is bordered by the [[Amnant Mountains]] to the west, which form a natural barrier, and the [[Valmiran Mountains]] through its eastern edge. The terrain gradually becomes flatter and more uniform as one moves inland, away from the influence of [[Taiylsh Desert/|coastal]] and [[wikipedia:Mountain|mountainous regions]].

The [[Tusil River]] bisects the desert, creating a natural division between its eastern and western sections. Approximately two-fifths of the desert's area lies to the west of the river, with the remaining territory to the east. Despite the generally uniform [[wikipedia:Desert_climate#Cold_desert_climates|cold desert climate]] across the region (characterized by [[wikipedia:Precipitation|low precipitation]], wide temperature fluctuations, and harsh seasonal conditions) the presence of the river produces subtle variations in the local environment and ecosystems on either side. Consequently, the Taiylsh Desert is frequently referred to in two distinct regions: the Western Taiylsh Desert and the Eastern Taiylsh Desert.
===Climate ===
The Taiylsh Desert is classified as a [[wikipedia:Desert_climate#Cold_desert_climates|cold desert]], with long, frigid winters, short, mild summers, and limited snowfall. Vegetation is sparse, primarily consisting of [[wikipedia:Shrub|hardy shrubs]] and grasses adapted to extreme temperature variations and prolonged periods of drought. The desert's flat expanses, combined with occasional sand basins and riverine influence, contribute to a stark yet ecologically significant landscape.
